label: Organ gun
description: Late medieval organ gun with FIVE iron barrels lying parallel to the ground in a shallow north-facing fan, mounted on a broad oak two-wheel carriage with iron straps and a short south trail. Exactly THREE blue-and-cream gambeson crew in steel kettle helmets at the sides and rear. Long barrel top surfaces with edge-on muzzle tips; no upward-facing bore openings.
